context:
Build pages as Preact components that render from manifest.json on initial
load, then enhance with DuckDB-WASM for interactive filtering. Pre-render
at build time for SEO. Keep the UI simple - data tables with sort/filter,
not complex dashboards.
description:
Build the primary navigation pages for the results explorer: the home/landing
page and the browse-by-benchmark and browse-by-platform index pages. These
are the entry points that let users discover what results are available and
navigate to specific result detail pages.

All pages consume data from the manifest.json and DuckDB read model produced
by the static build pipeline. Pages should work without JavaScript for basic
content (pre-rendered) but use DuckDB-WASM for interactive filtering.

anti_patterns.dont: build custom filter UI when a simple dropdown + text input suffices
anti_patterns.why: over-engineering the filter UX delays launch

anti_patterns.dont: load the full DuckDB database just to render the home page
anti_patterns.instead: lazy-load DuckDB only when filtering is activated

preserves.behavior: Explorer home and browse pages must work with the pre-built manifest.json - no runtime API calls
Pre-rendered HTML must be valid and useful without JavaScript for SEO and accessibility

verifications.description: Vite build succeeds with no TypeScript errors

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run build && test -f dist/index.html && grep -q 'Results Explorer' dist/index.html
verifications.description: Home page is pre-rendered with real data
verifications.expected: Exit code 0 - home page exists and contains expected content

verifications.description: Browse pages are pre-rendered for each benchmark and platform in manifest

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm run build
verifications.description: Unit tests for page components pass

work_units.notes:
The home page should show:
- Hero section: "BenchBox Results Explorer" with a brief description
- Summary cards: count of results, benchmarks, platforms
- Recent results: last 10 results with benchmark, platform, scale, date, duration
- Quick navigation: links to benchmark index and platform index
- Search/filter teaser: "Filter results by benchmark, platform, or scale factor"

Data source: `manifest.json` (pre-loaded, no DuckDB needed for initial render).
work_units.summary: Implement the explorer home page at /results/

work_units.notes:
One page per benchmark (e.g., `/results/tpch/`, `/results/tpcds/`):
- Benchmark name, description, and metadata (query count, official spec link)
- Results table: all results for this benchmark, sorted by date desc
  Columns: platform, scale_factor, total_duration_ms, queries_passed, date
- Filters: scale factor dropdown, platform multi-select
- "Compare" checkboxes: select 2+ results and click "Compare" to navigate
  to the compare view

Data source: `manifest.json` filtered by benchmark, with DuckDB for
interactive filtering.
work_units.summary: Implement the benchmark index page at /results/{benchmark}/

work_units.notes:
One page per platform (e.g., `/results/duckdb/`, `/results/datafusion/`):
- Platform name, description, and metadata (supported benchmarks)
- Results table: all results for this platform, sorted by date desc
  Columns: benchmark, scale_factor, total_duration_ms, queries_passed, date
- Filters: benchmark dropdown, scale factor dropdown
- "Compare" checkboxes: only enabled when selected results share the same
  benchmark AND scale factor. Cross-benchmark and cross-scale compare
  entry points must NOT be offered because the compare view hard-blocks
  those combinations. Disable or hide checkboxes for results that would
  create an incompatible cohort with the current selection.

Data source: same as benchmark index, filtered by platform.
work_units.summary: Implement the platform index page at /results/{platform}/

work_units.notes:
Enhance browse pages with DuckDB-WASM powered filtering:
- Filter by scale factor, date range, platform/benchmark
- Sort by any column (duration, date, query count)
- URL query params reflect active filters (shareable filtered views)
- Loading indicator while DuckDB initializes
- Graceful degradation: if DuckDB fails to load, manifest.json data
  still renders (just without interactive filtering)
work_units.summary: Add interactive DuckDB-WASM filtering to browse pages

work_units.notes:
During Vite build, read manifest.json and generate static HTML for:
- Each benchmark: `/results/tpch/index.html`, `/results/tpcds/index.html`, etc.
- Each platform: `/results/duckdb/index.html`, `/results/datafusion/index.html`, etc.
This ensures browse pages are crawlable by search engines and load instantly
without client-side rendering. JavaScript enhances with interactive filtering.
work_units.summary: Pre-render known browse pages at build time
